scope: Ordinary public declared-only cached clones; source-reachable foreach tables, singleton/held int references and shallow untyped Payload. No callback, readonly, active collection or dynamic buckets.

cases.source:
<?php
class CachedScalar110 { public int $value = 1; public int $other = 10; }
$cold = new CachedScalar110();
$coldcopy = clone $cold;
$coldcopy->value = 2;
echo 'S:', $cold->value, '|', $coldcopy->value, '|';
unset($cold, $coldcopy);
$source = new CachedScalar110();
foreach ($source as $value) {}
unset($value);
echo 'M|';
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->value = 2;
$source->other = 30;
echo $source->value, '|', $copy->value, '|', $source->other, '|', $copy->other, '|';
unset($copy->value);
echo isset($source->value) ? 'L|' : 'bad|';
echo isset($copy->value) ? 'bad|' : 'Z|';
$copy->value = 4;
echo $source->value, '|', $copy->value, '|';
unset($source, $copy);
echo 'E|';

<?php
class CachedSingleton110 { public int $value = 1; }
$source = new CachedSingleton110();
$alias =& $source->value;
unset($alias);
foreach ($source as $value) {}
unset($value);
echo 'U:';
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->value = 7;
echo $source->value, '|', $copy->value, '|';
try { $copy->value = 'bad'; } catch (TypeError $caught) { echo 'T|'; }
echo $source->value, '|';
unset($source->value);
$copy->value = 9;
echo $copy->value, '|';
unset($caught, $source, $copy);
echo 'E|';

<?php
class CachedHeld110 { public int $value = 1; }
$source = new CachedHeld110();
$held =& $source->value;
foreach ($source as $value) {}
unset($value);
echo 'H:';
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->value = 7;
echo $source->value, '|', $copy->value, '|', $held, '|';
$held = 8;
echo $source->value, '|', $copy->value, '|';
unset($source->value);
try { $held = 'bad'; } catch (TypeError $caught) { echo 'T|'; }
echo $held, '|', $copy->value, '|';
unset($copy->value);
$held = 'free';
echo $held, '|';
unset($caught, $held, $source, $copy);
echo 'E|';

<?php
class CachedPayload110 {
    public int $value = 5;
    public function __destruct() { echo 'P', $this->value, '|'; }
}
class CachedOwner110 {
    public int $tag = 1;
    public $payload = null;
    public function __destruct() { echo 'D', $this->tag, '|'; }
}
$source = new CachedOwner110();
$source->payload = new CachedPayload110();
foreach ($source as $value) {}
unset($value);
echo 'P:';
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->tag = 2;
$copy->payload->value = 7;
echo $source->payload === $copy->payload ? 'S|' : 'bad|';
unset($source);
echo 'A|';
unset($copy);
echo 'E|';

<?php
class CachedForeach110 { public int $a = 1; public int $b = 10; }
$source = new CachedForeach110();
foreach ($source as $value) {}
unset($value);
echo 'F:';
$copy = clone $source;
$copy->a = 2;
$source->b = 30;
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, ':', $value, '|'; }
unset($key, $value);
echo 'S|';
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, ':', $value, '|'; }
unset($key, $value);
unset($copy->a);
echo 'U|';
foreach ($copy as $key => $value) { echo $key, ':', $value, '|'; }
unset($key, $value);
echo 'S|';
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, ':', $value, '|'; }
unset($key, $value, $source, $copy);
echo 'E|';
